info.title: trakr
info.description: Launch monitor bridge for golf simulators. Discover a launch monitor, connect, arm it, and stream shot events. This same API backs the trakr CLI and the trakr Tauri UI, so anything the UI can do, an agent can do by calling this API directly.

get.summary: Discover launch monitors on the network
get.description: Broadcasts a discovery request on every active local network interface (WiFi or wired) automatically and collects replies for `window_ms`. Does not require or affect an active session.

parameters.name: broadcast
parameters.description: Comma-separated extra directed broadcast address(es) to scan, beyond the ones auto-detected from this host's own network interfaces. Only needed for a network this host isn't itself on.

example.help: no launch monitor is connected. POST /v1/session to connect

post.description: Idempotent: calling this again for the same device is a no-op. Connecting to a second device while one is active returns 409 — call DELETE /v1/session first.

kind.description: "simulated" connects a fake device with no hardware, for testing via POST /v1/session/shot.

name.description: Box name from GET /v1/devices. Omit with address to auto-discover the first box found. For kind "simulated", this is just a display name (default "Simulated Launch Monitor").

address.description: Box IPv4 address. Required together with name. Ignored for kind "simulated".

broadcast.description: Extra directed broadcast address(es) to scan if auto-discovering, beyond this host's own network interfaces.

202.description: Connecting; poll GET /v1/session or stream GET /v1/events

409.description: A different session is already active

delete.description: Idempotent: returns 200 even if no session was active.

post.description: Activates lasers/cameras and puts the device in a waiting-for-shot state.

post.summary: Fire a synthetic shot into the current session
post.description: Only works on a kind "simulated" session (see POST /v1/session) -- real hardware reports its own shots and can't be told to fake one. Either raw numbers, or a club (see GET /v1/clubs) to generate plausible ball data -- optionally with a carry_yd or a player whose bag (see /v1/players) supplies it. hla_deg/axis_deg apply as shot shape either way.

club.description: Generate plausible ball data for this club instead of speed_mph/vla_deg/spin_rpm above (see GET /v1/clubs).

carry_yd.description: Target carry for `club`. Defaults to `player`'s bag entry, or the club's reference carry.

player.description: Look up `club`'s carry from this player's bag (GET /v1/players/{name}).

422.description: Connected device is not simulated, or unknown club

get.description: Typical launch conditions per club, used to turn a club + carry distance into plausible ball data for POST /v1/session/shot. Not a physics model -- see trakr_core::player for the method.

post.description: Bag starts empty -- add clubs with PUT /v1/players/{name}/clubs/{club}.

409.description: A player with this name already exists

delete.summary: Remove a player and their bag

put.summary: Set (or update) one club's carry distance in a player's bag

delete.summary: Remove one club from a player's bag
delete.description: Idempotent: removing a club that isn't in the bag is not an error.

get.description: Persisted to disk -- survives a daemon/app restart. See docs/skytrak-protocol/chipping-mode.md.

post.description: Partial update: any field omitted is left unchanged. Applies immediately to any active session (no reconnect needed) and is saved to disk before responding.

chip_on_lob_wedge.description: Auto-switch to Chipping when the sim reports a lob wedge ("LW").

force_chip_distance_yd.description: Auto-switch to Chipping within this many yards of the target, overriding club selection entirely. Send null to disable; omit to leave unchanged.

chip_via_putting.description: Whether Chipping arms the box's Putting mode (true, default) or Normal mode (false).

200.description: Updated settings, same shape as GET

get.description: text/event-stream. Each event's `event:` line is one of discovered, connected, disconnected, status, ready, shot_started, shot, misread, error; `data:` is the JSON-serialized trakr_core::Event with a matching "type" field. Consume with `curl -N http://127.0.0.1:7011/v1/events` or any SSE/EventSource client.
